description: Send WhatsApp, SMS and email, verify OTP codes and run campaigns with SendKuy.

tool_signatures.name: sendkuy_control_campaign
tool_signatures.description: Pause a running campaign, resume a paused one, or cancel it for good. Pause is the emergency brake when a campaign is going out wrong: messages not yet sent stay unsent until you resume. Cancel cannot be undone.

tool_signatures.name: sendkuy_find_contacts
tool_signatures.description: Find one saved contact by phone number (E.164) or by external_id, the id your own system gave the customer. Returns contact: null when nobody matches. Use the contact id (con_...) as a recipient in sendkuy_send_message.

tool_signatures.name: sendkuy_get_account
tool_signatures.description: Read the SendKuy account behind this API key: plan, remaining credits per channel (WhatsApp, SMS, email), messages used this billing period, the rate limit, and the scopes this key holds. Check credits before a large send. plan, credits and usage are null for SendKuy staff keys.

tool_signatures.name: sendkuy_get_campaign
tool_signatures.description: Read a campaign: status, progress (processed_contacts of total_contacts), why it is paused, and delivery stats (sent, delivered, failed, opened, replied, unsubscribed) overall and per channel.

tool_signatures.name: sendkuy_list_campaigns
tool_signatures.description: List campaigns, newest first, with their status and audience size (total_contacts). Campaign content is written in the SendKuy dashboard; a draft found here is ready to run with sendkuy_start_campaign.

tool_signatures.name: sendkuy_list_groups
tool_signatures.description: List the contact groups in SendKuy with how many contacts each holds. Put a group id (grp_...) in the to field of sendkuy_send_message to send to every member; check contact_count first, because every member is charged.

tool_signatures.name: sendkuy_start_campaign
tool_signatures.description: Start a draft or scheduled campaign. An instant campaign starts sending to every eligible contact in its group, is refused with insufficient_credits when the balance does not cover them, and spends real SendKuy credit. A scheduled or recurring campaign waits for its time. If a person is in the conversation, tell them the campaign name and total_contacts before you start it. Pause or cancel it with sendkuy_control_campaign.
